platform: WordPress + Divi (credited to '75 Degrees West' in the footer)
purpose: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY. Per the pipeline's anti-pattern lock, nothing observed here seeds design tokens, layout, or section order for the generated site. The owl template is the sole design authority.
strengths: Strong, unmistakable brand mark and a committed single-accent red (#DF0028) used consistently.
Technology Partners strip (Canon, Microsoft 365, N-able, EFI, Cisco) is real, verifiable trust equity.
Industry segmentation (Healthcare, Manufacturing, Government, Education, Legal, Non Profit) is genuinely useful B2B qualification.
The four value blocks near the footer contain the site's best copy — including the 4-hour on-site guarantee.
Footer lists all five office addresses with phone numbers.
UserWay accessibility widget and TrustedSite badge present.
weaknesses: The single strongest selling point on the whole site — 'technicians will be on-site in 4 hours or less, guaranteed' — is in small grey body text at the very bottom of the page, below six industry icons.
Hero is a product announcement ('Introducing the Canon imagePROGRAF TZ-Series Wide Format MFP'), not a customer-outcome message. No hero CTA button.
Copyright reads 2021; several pages carry stale 'over 40 years' copy while /about says over 50.
No testimonials, case studies, or named customers anywhere on the site.
No pricing or lease-transparency content of any kind, in a market whose #1 complaint is opaque lease pricing.
Service pages are thin and inconsistent — /manage-it-services renders essentially empty; several pages show literal 'Z' characters where an icon font failed.
Every page ends with a stray bare 'reCAPTCHA' string.
Six red line-art industry icons compete visually with the red logo and red CTA buttons; the accent loses its job as a call-to-action signal.
Local SEO is thin: only two geo pages (Scranton copiers, Wilkes-Barre IT), no page for Kingston, Hazleton, Williamsport or Stroudsburg despite offices in most of them.
before_after_story: Today the site opens with a product SKU and closes with the guarantee. The rebuild opens with the guarantee — on site in four hours, locally owned since 1969, five offices across NEPA — and treats the Canon hardware as proof, not as the headline. It also gives each office city a real service-area page instead of leaving four of five locations invisible to local search.
